name: Wikipedia
goodFor: Encyclopedia articles, for a lead paragraph and a thumbnail on almost any topic.
attribution: The article's title, a link to the article, and the licence name (CC BY-SA 4.0).

checked.basis: secondary sources and Creative Commons' compatible-licences page; Wikimedia's own terms not opened

notes: Text is CC BY-SA 4.0, so copied text may only go in share-alike/, never bank/. Images carry their own per-file licences. Articles often read above introductory level.
